I1: Leakage-aware partition: test data are separate events, time blocks, wells, profiles, sites or data sets (Y); random or ratio split of windows, traces or samples, or not described (N); no supervised training (NA)
I2: Independent test set not used for training or model selection (Y); only validation or cross-validation reported, or not described (N); no supervised training (NA)
R2: Reference standard: field labels made or checked by analysts or an independent catalogue (Y); synthetic ground truth only (S); automated labels without verification or not stated (N); no labels used (NA)
E1: External validity: test on a different site, well, sensor type or acquisition (Y); synthetic-to-field test at the same site only (P); none (N)
E2: Robustness: controlled perturbation or stratified test (SNR levels, added noise, channel or receiver loss, velocity-model error) (Y/N)
O1: Continuous-data evaluation: detector applied to continuous records or compared with a catalogue over a monitoring period (Y/N); picking- or location-only study (NA)
O2: Class prevalence of the evaluation data stated (Y/N); not a detection or classification task (NA)
O3: False alarms per unit time reported (Y/N); not a detection task (NA)
O4: Latency or throughput with hardware (Y); only one of the two (P); neither (N)
